header: Extras on top of a plan
subheader: Bought and dropped one at a time, never bundled into a bigger tier.
lead: Each extra is billed per practice per month unless the line says otherwise, and each can be switched off at the end of any billing period.
note: All figures are net per practice per month. Switching an add-on off takes effect at the end of the billing period; nothing is refunded pro rata.
cta_label: Add an extra to your practice

addons.title: Online booking
addons.text: Patients book free slots themselves from your website, inside the rules you set for each treatment type.

addons.title: Patient app with exercise plans
addons.text: Exercise plans, videos and home-programme reminders on the patient's own phone.

addons.title: Additional treatment address
addons.text: One more address in the same appointment book, with its own rooms, opening hours and practitioners.

addons.title: Printed recall letters
addons.text: Base fee for the print service. Each letter itself costs €0.95 including postage.

addons.title: Waiting-list automation
addons.text: A cancelled slot is offered to the waiting list by SMS in the order you set, without anyone ringing round.

addons.title: Document storage, 50 GB
addons.text: Cheaper than the metered rate once a practice stores more than about 35 GB.

addons.title: Card-terminal connection
addons.text: The invoice is settled at the terminal and marked paid in Talbrunn without retyping.

addons.title: Second data location
addons.text: A second Austrian data centre holds a live copy. For practices with a business-continuity requirement in their contract.
